slides.dek: Low stakes, soft pacing, zero homework. Save this for the next rough one.

slides.title: Laid-Back Camp
slides.why: Camping, cocoa, and nothing going wrong. The most calming show anime has ever produced.

slides.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
slides.why: Gentle ghost stories about choosing kindness. Melancholy in the way that heals.

slides.title: Barakamon
slides.why: A burnt-out calligrapher gets exiled to a village island. Funny, warm, and only 12 episodes.

slides.title: K-On!
slides.why: A band that mostly drinks tea. Pure warmth, no plot required, and the friendships land anyway.

slides.title: Aria the Animation
slides.why: Gondola tours on a terraformed Mars. The gold standard of nothing happens, beautifully.

slides.h: Rough week? [[Come back]] to this list.
slides.body: Drop your own comfort rewatch in the comments so this post becomes the full list.
